description: Declare INDEPENDENCE 11/3/26 (Official political campaign T-shirt of Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate District 9) This shirt marks a choice — and a moment. “Declare Independence” isn’t a slogan about looking different; it’s about acting differently. It’s a call to step outside party machinery, reject automatic allegiance, and put judgment, conscience, and voters first. The date grounds that declaration in time, signaling a clear break from business-as-usual politics and a commitment to something new. Printed on a soft, lightweight unisex tee made from Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, this shirt is built for real campaign days — comfortable enough for canvassing, town halls, and conversations that matter. Reinforced seams, a retail crew fit, and a durable, high-clarity print ensure the message stays sharp and readable, wear after wear. Wear it as a statement of intent: independence isn’t assumed — it’s declared. Product Features • 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (lightweight, breathable) • Retail crew neck with ribbed knit collar and seam for shape retention • Side seams and shoulder tape for improved fit and long-term structure • Tear-away label; REACH certified; adult sizing; ethically produced • Durable DTF/DTG print for sharp, legible campaign graphics Care Instructions • Machine wash cold (max 30°C / 90°F) • Non-chlorine bleach as needed • Tumble dry low heat • Iron, steam, or dry at medium heat • Do not dry clean Paid for by Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate, P.O. Box 244, Troy, MI 48099. Proceeds benefit the campaign committee.
